discovery: A handful of town guards are making a desperate last stand against a rising tide of undead.

choices.label: Investigate
choices.description: Walk in and see what's happening

choices.label: Sneak Around
choices.description: Stealth check to glimpse it unseen

choices.label: Ignore
choices.description: ESC also cancels - just keep walking

sneak_success: You skirt the battle and slip past while the undead are fully occupied with the guards.
sneak_fail: A stray skeleton breaks off from the guards' line and shambles straight for you.
ignore: You leave the guards to hold the line alone and hope they last the night.

victim_data.dialogue: We can't hold much longer - lend us a hand!
thanks: We held the line thanks to you. Well fought, adventurer.
after: Still catching my breath - but we're alive, thanks to you.

waves.discovery: Just as the barricade falls quiet, the earth beyond it churns - a second, larger wave of undead is dragging itself out of the ground.

aftermath.discovery: The last of the undead crumble to dust. The surviving guards are already dragging bodies clear of the barricade, watching the treeline for any more.

choices.label: Help Fortify the Barricade
choices.description: Stay and lend a hand in case more come
choices.outcome: You spend the next while hauling timber and driving stakes alongside the guards. By the time you're done, the barricade could hold against twice as many.

choices.label: Move On
choices.description: ESC also cancels - the guards can finish on their own
choices.outcome: You leave the guards to finish shoring up the barricade themselves and continue on your way.
